items.headline: Bourgeois' game-winner lifts Middle Tennessee over Western Kentucky 51-42
items.description: — Dominic Bourgeois kicked a 48-yard field goal with 1 second remaining, and Middle Tennessee added a touchdown on Western Kentucky’s last-ditch lateral attempt to beat the Hilltoppers 51-42 on Saturday in the “100 Miles of Hate” rivalry.
